pass.description: true only when every law at the baseline not named in the scope keeps, on the staged branch, its verdict and each plant's outcome.

violations.description: Each moved law or plant: {law, plant?, baseline, branch, reason} as compareBaselineLoop returns it.

excepted.description: The law ids the scope names, excepted because their verdict is meant to change.

baseline.description: loop/loop-result at the baseline commit: {laws: [{id, verdict, plants: [{id, outcome}]}]}.

branch.description: loop/loop-result on the staged branch, same shape.
